title: #101 Automobile
prompt: Some people think that the automobile has improved modern life. Others think that the automobile has caused serious problems. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people think that the automobile has improved modern life.
Others think that the automobile has caused serious problems.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car makes life easier by providing a fast way to travel, allowing people to save time and spend more time with family.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The car makes life easier by providing a fast way to travel, allowing people to save time and spend more time with family.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, the car causes environmental problems because burning fuel releases bad air, leading to pollution and poor air quality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, the car causes environmental problems because burning fuel releases bad air, leading to pollution and poor air quality.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first advantage of the car is that it makes travel much easier, providing people with a simple way to get to places in daily life, allowing them to spend less time on long journeys.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first advantage of the car is that it makes travel much easier, providing people with a simple way to get to places in daily life, allowing them to spend less time on long journeys.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, the car also causes serious problems for the environment because it uses fuel and produces dirty air, leading to worse air quality, especially in big cities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, the car also causes serious problems for the environment because it uses fuel and produces dirty air, leading to worse air quality, especially in big cities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The automobile provides great convenience and mobility for people to travel and enjoy a good life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The automobile provides great convenience and mobility for people to travel and enjoy a good life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The automobile causes serious environmental problems, mainly due to pollution and poor air quality in cities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The automobile causes serious environmental problems, mainly due to pollution and poor air quality in cities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car has greatly improved modern life by providing a fast and easy way to travel, allowing businesses to grow in new areas and people to get jobs further away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The car has greatly improved modern life by providing a fast and easy way to travel, allowing businesses to grow in new areas and people to get jobs further away.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, the car also creates serious problems, mainly heavy traffic jams in big cities, which leads to increased air pollution and health issues.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, the car also creates serious problems, mainly heavy traffic jams in big cities, which leads to increased air pollution and health issues.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the impact of automobiles on modern life, balancing both benefits and drawbacks
keyArguments: The automobile has revolutionized transportation, offering unparalleled convenience and mobility, which has significantly improved modern life by making travel faster and more accessible.

However, the widespread use of cars has led to severe issues such as traffic congestion, environmental pollution, and overreliance on fossil fuels, which have negatively impacted urban living and sustainability.
